name: calendar366
description: Manage calendars, events and tasks in Calendar 366 through Claude.
long_description: Lets Claude read and manage your events and tasks in Calendar 366. Ask Claude to show your agenda, create or move items, duplicate entries, or mark tasks as done — directly from chat. Requires the Calendar 366 app to be installed and running.

tools.name: get_current_time
tools.description: Get the user's current local date, time and timezone.

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: List all calendars and task lists grouped by account.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: List events and tasks in a date range.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Get full details of a single event or task.

tools.name: create_item
tools.description: Create a new event or task.

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: Update an existing event or task.

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: Delete an event or task (requires user confirmation).

tools.name: duplicate_item
tools.description: Duplicate an existing event or task.
